subtitle: Marthanda Varma’s ruthless war on the eight houses that strangled Travancore

panels.shot: low-angle wide of a stormy palace courtyard with Marthanda Varma in the foreground and dim silhouettes of crumbling manor houses behind him
panels.action: Marthanda Varma stands stern and unyielding in royal attire, sword sheathed, as in the distant haze grand Nair mansions tilt and collapse, palm trees bending under monsoon winds around the Travancore palace.

dialogue.text: Between 1729 and 1733, Marthanda Varma broke the proud Ettuveetil Pillamar—replacing scattered noble power with a harsher crown, and leaving Travancore stronger, but scarred.

i18n.hi: १७२९ से १७३३ के बीच मर्थंड वर्मा ने घमंडी एट्टूवीटिल पिल्लमर को कुचल दिया—बिखरी रईसी को कड़े ताज से बदल कर, त्रावणकोर को मजबूत किया, पर जख्मी भी।

panels.shot: wide shot of the Venad countryside with multiple fortified manors dotting the landscape and the sea glinting in the distance
panels.action: A panoramic view of the southern Travancore heartland shows rich paddy fields, temple towers, and several large Nair manors rising like small forts, while far off the Arabian Sea gleams under a hazy sky.

dialogue.text: Early eighteenth-century Venad was a patchwork of powers: Nair manors, temple boards, Yogakkar councils and royal cousins, each with swords, fields and followers of their own.

i18n.hi: अठारहवीं सदी की शुरुआत का वेनाड टुकड़ों का जाल था: नायर थरवाड़, मंदिर ट्रस्ट, योगकार पंचायतें और शाही चचेरे, सबके पास अपनी तलवारें, खेत और चेले।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a shadowy council hall with Marthanda Varma seated while unseen aristocrats loom as silhouettes
panels.action: Inside a dim traditional hall, Marthanda Varma sits upright on a simple throne, his face young yet watchful, while in the shadows behind carved pillars the silhouettes of Nair chiefs and madampimar lean together in private counsel.

dialogue.text: Above them, but not yet over them, stood the Rajah. Even court chroniclers admitted that before Marthanda Varma, royal orders had to weave around the power of the houses.

i18n.hi: इन सबके ऊपर, पर अभी उन पर हावी नहीं, राजा खड़ा था। दरबारी इतिहासकार भी मानते हैं कि मर्थंड वर्मा से पहले शाही हुक्म भी घरानों की ताकत को घूमा कर लिखे जाते थे।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Marthanda Varma’s face as he listens to a report, half in shadow
panels.action: Marthanda Varma leans slightly forward on the throne, brows tightened, as a court officer off-frame speaks; one side of his face is lit by lamplight, the other is swallowed in shadow.

dialogue.text: Shungoonny Menon writes of chiefs who withheld revenue, raised private levies and played princes against each other. The so-called Ettuveetil Pillamar stood at the heart of this web.

i18n.hi: शुंगून्नी मेनन उन प्रधानों का जिक्र करते हैं जो कर रोकते, निजी फौजें उठाते और राजकुमारों को आपस में भिड़ाते थे। इन्हीं में एट्टूवीटिल पिल्लमर इस जाल के बीचोंबीच थे।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of a Nair manor compound bustling with armed retainers
panels.action: A broad Nair mansion with tiled roofs and a central courtyard teems with armed retainers in traditional dress, some drilling with spears, others lounging with obvious confidence, while smoke rises from kitchen sheds inside the compound walls.

dialogue.text: Legends number eight great houses, but temple documents and the State Manual complicate the list. What is clear is their habit: they treated land, men and even princes as their inheritance.

i18n.hi: कथाओं में आठ बड़े घर गिने जाते हैं, पर मंदिर के कागज़ और स्टेट मैनुअल खुद सूची उलझा देते हैं। साफ बस इतना है: उनकी फितरत, ज़मीन, लोग, यहां तक कि राजकुमारों को भी अपनी जायदाद मानना।

panels.shot: medium shot of Marthanda Varma in a private chamber with palm-leaf documents spread before him
panels.action: In a quiet chamber, Marthanda Varma sits cross-legged beside a low wooden desk, palm-leaf records and revenue accounts laid out, as he traces lines with his finger, jaw set in resolve.

dialogue.text: Nagam Aiya’s State Manual hints at the king’s calculation. To fight external threats, he needed money and soldiers that answered the crown, not the manors.

i18n.hi: नागम अय्यर का स्टेट मैनुअल राजा की चाल समझाता है। बाहर के दुश्मनों से लड़ने को उसे ऐसी फौज और पैसा चाहिए था जो ताज को जवाब दे, थरवाड़ को नहीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of a temple courtyard at dusk with notable figures in tense conversation
panels.action: In a temple courtyard lit by oil lamps, Nair noblemen, Yogakkar representatives and a royal cousin stand in a uneasy circle, their gestures sharp and wary, while Brahmin priests pass at a distance, carefully avoiding the knot of power.

dialogue.text: Opposition gathered in courtyards and shrines. The Yogakkar, pillar-families and certain Thampis feared that if this prince succeeded, their say over temple wealth and village affairs would vanish.

i18n.hi: विरोध आंगनों और देवालयों में सिमटने लगा। योगकार, खंभा-परिवार और कुछ थंपियों को डर था, अगर यह राजकुमार जीत गया तो मंदिरों की दौलत और गांवों पर उनकी पकड़ गायब हो जाएगी।

panels.shot: low-angle shot of Marthanda Varma addressing a small group of trusted officers
panels.action: In an open verandah by torchlight, Marthanda Varma stands with a firm stance, addressing a handful of Nair and non-Nair officers who listen intently, hands on the hilts of their swords.

dialogue.speaker: marthanda_varma_and_the_ettuveetil_pillamar
dialogue.text: If the house commands the sword, the realm is no kingdom. That must end.

i18n.hi: जब तलवार घर के हुक्म में हो, तो राज कोई राज नहीं रहता। यह खत्म होना था।

panels.shot: montage-like wide shot of simultaneous arrests at different manors under monsoon clouds
panels.action: Under a dark monsoon sky, royal detachments advance into separate Nair compounds: gates stand open but tense, chiefs are surrounded, and retainers lower their weapons as rain begins to fall across the scene.

dialogue.text: Between 1729 and 1733, the pattern is clear in the records: sudden moves, chiefs seized, their garrisons disarmed, their fields and granaries taken into royal hands.

i18n.hi: १७२९ से १७३३ के बीच दस्तावेज़ों में एक ही पैटर्न उभरता है: अचानक धावे, सरदार दबोचे गए, उनकी छावनियां निःशस्त्र, उनके खेत और कोठार राज के कब्ज़े में।

panels.shot: medium shot of a line of bound aristocrats being led under guard
panels.action: A row of high-born Nair men, hands tied with rope, walk barefoot between palace guards; some stare ahead in shock, others glance back towards the unseen direction of their homes.

dialogue.text: Nagam Aiya records executions and exiles. Some were put to death after trial; others were marched away, stripped of office and title, their names fading into the file of convicts.

i18n.hi: नागम अय्यर फाँसियों और जला-वतनों का हिसाब देते हैं। कुछ को मुकदमे के बाद मारा गया; कुछ बेइज्जत मार्च कराए गए, ओहदा और खिताब छीन लिए गए, उनके नाम कैदियों की फाइलों में खो गए।

panels.shot: dramatic wide shot of a great manor house being demolished by workers under guard
panels.action: Workers with crowbars and wooden mallets tear down the high laterite walls of a grand manor under the watch of royal soldiers, roof tiles crashing as a carved doorway collapses into dust.

dialogue.text: Certain houses were not merely confiscated but erased. The Manual speaks of mansions levelled, granaries seized, and ancestral compounds reduced to rubble and government land.

i18n.hi: कुछ घरों को सिर्फ ज़ब्त नहीं, मिटा दिया गया। मैनुअल में हवेलियां ढहाई जाने, कोठार कब्ज़ा होने और पुश्तैनी आंगन मलबा व खालिस सरकारी ज़मीन बनते दिखते हैं।

panels.shot: somber mid-wide shot of women and children under guard near a coastal village
panels.action: On a sandy coastal track near a Mukkuvar fishing village, a small group of women and children from noble households stand huddled, guarded by palace men, while in the distance catamarans rest on the shore.

dialogue.text: Here the record turns stark. Nagam Aiya notes that some women and children of the fallen families were sold to Mukkuvar fishermen—an aftershock of conquest rarely named in royal praise.

i18n.hi: यहां रिकॉर्ड सख्त हो जाता है। नागम अय्यर लिखते हैं कि गिरी हुई कुलों की कुछ औरतें और बच्चे मुक्कुवर मछुआरों को बेच दिए गए—फतह का यह झटका शाही स्तुति में शायद ही कभी लिखा जाता है।

panels.shot: close-up on Marthanda Varma’s hand sealing a document, with a faint tremor visible
panels.action: A close view shows Marthanda Varma’s hand pressing a royal seal onto a palm-leaf order, the muscles in his fingers tense, a faint tremor betraying the weight of what he signs.

dialogue.text: Shungoonny Menon, himself loyal to the crown, praises the decision as necessary. Yet every signature meant a family undone, a local world broken to make a larger state.

i18n.hi: शुंगून्नी मेनन, जो खुद ताज के वफादार थे, इस फैसले को ज़रूरी बता कर सराहते हैं। पर हर दस्तखत का मतलब था एक खानदान उजड़ना, एक छोटा लोक टूट कर बड़े राज्य में घुल जाना।

panels.shot: wide shot of a formal court where new officials are being appointed in place of the old chiefs
panels.action: In a bright audience hall, Marthanda Varma sits in full regalia as a line of new officials—Dalava, Valia Sarvadhi Kariakkar, junior Kariakkars, Manikars and Adhikaris—step forward to receive symbols of office before assembled courtiers.

dialogue.text: In place of the manors rose a hierarchy: Dalava at the head, then Valia Sarvadhi Kariakkars, Kariakkars, Manikars and Adhikaris—officers owed not to clan but to crown.

i18n.hi: थरवाड़ों की जगह एक सीढ़ीदार राजतंत्र खड़ा हुआ: ऊपर दलवा, फिर वालिया सार्वधि करीयक्कार, करीयक्कार, मणिकार और अधिकारी—ऐसे अफसर जो कुल से नहीं, ताज से बंधे थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of a Kariakkar collecting revenue in a village, with old Nair landlords watching from the background
panels.action: A Kariakkar, palm-leaf ledger in hand, sits beneath a banyan tree taking measured grain from villagers, while former Nair landlords stand a little apart, arms folded, their authority reduced to watchful silence.

dialogue.text: Jeffrey and K.N. Ganesh read this as the decline of old Nair dominance. Revenue and military command flowed upward, tightening the state and binding village life to the palace.

i18n.hi: जेफ़्री और के. एन. गणेश इसे पुराने नायर वर्चस्व के ढलान की तरह पढ़ते हैं। लगान और फौजी कमान ऊपर खिंच गई, राज्य कस गया और गांव की सांस महल से जुड़ गई।

panels.shot: wide shot of disciplined royal troops drilling in an open field with the palace in the distance
panels.action: In an open field under a clear sky, ranks of uniformed royal soldiers drill in straight lines with spears and muskets, the Travancore palace rising calm and solid beyond them.

dialogue.text: With noble levies broken or absorbed, the king built a standing force. When later wars came, Travancore could deploy an army that answered a single voice.

i18n.hi: जब रईसों की फौजें टूटीं या घुलीं, राजा ने स्थायी सेना बनाई। बाद की जंगों में त्रावणकोर ऐसी फ़ौज उतार सका जो बस एक आवाज़ सुनती थी।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Marthanda Varma at an older age, looking out over his kingdom from a balcony
panels.action: An older Marthanda Varma, features lined but eyes steady, rests his hands on a stone balcony rail as he looks over the clustered roofs and temple towers of Thiruvananthapuram spread beneath a soft evening light.

dialogue.speaker: marthanda_varma_and_the_ettuveetil_pillamar
dialogue.text: The realm stands whole—but whose tears built its walls?

i18n.hi: राज्य तो अखंड खड़ा है—पर इसकी दीवारें किसके आँसुओं से गूंथी गईं?

panels.shot: slow pull-back from a quiet ruined foundation of a former manor now overgrown, with a distant modern Travancore-era building visible
panels.action: Stone foundations of a long-destroyed manor lie overgrown with grass and small shrubs, while beyond them rises a later Travancore-era administrative building, its lines plain yet enduring under a calm sky.

dialogue.text: Today, the eight houses survive mostly in stories and disputes over names. The centralized Travancore they helped force into being still shapes Kerala’s memory of power, order and the costs of both.

i18n.hi: आज आठ घर ज़्यादातर किस्सों और नामों की लड़ाइयों में बचे हैं। वही केंद्रीकृत त्रावणकोर, जिसे उन्होंने अनजाने गढ़ने में मदद की, आज भी केरल की सत्ता, अनुशासन और इन दोनों की कीमतों की याद को आकार देता है।

subtitle_i18n.en: Marthanda Varma’s ruthless war on the eight houses that strangled Travancore
subtitle_i18n.hi: मर्थंड वर्मा की बेरहम जंग, जिसने त्रावणकोर को जकड़े आठ घरों को तोड़ डाला
